system.description: You or a touched ally become becomes effectively invisible to undead, demons, or creatures of similar ilk of level 3 or less until you use a ten-minute or longer recovery. This effect ends if the target does something to reveal their presence or position—attacking, using an ability, moving a large object, and so on. Effort: Increase the maximum level of foes who can't perceive the invisible target by 1. Action to initiate.
